info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listAccreditation returns the caller org's accreditation records with their
get.description:
listAccreditation returns the caller org's accreditation records with their
method, basis and current state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

post.summary:
createAccreditation records an ASSERTED accreditation state for one of the org's
subjects.
post.description:
createAccreditation records an ASSERTED accreditation state for one of the org's
subjects. A create can only ever record an assertion — every confirmed, rejected
or expired state goes through the decision endpoint, so it always names the
reviewer who recorded it.

get.summary: getAccreditation returns one of the caller org's accreditation records.
get.description: getAccreditation returns one of the caller org's accreditation records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the accreditation id from the path, as returned by create.

post.summary:
decideAccreditation records a reviewer's decision on an accreditation record and
attributes it to them.
post.description:
decideAccreditation records a reviewer's decision on an accreditation record and
attributes it to them. It requires an org admin or platform reviewer: the
platform never confirms on its own, and even a provider_verified state carries
the reviewer who recorded the evidence.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the accreditation id from the path; a body value is ignored.

get.summary:
auditRead returns the caller org's compliance actions from the shared
tamper-evident audit trail — who started or decided what, and when.
get.description:
auditRead returns the caller org's compliance actions from the shared
tamper-evident audit trail — who started or decided what, and when. The org is
pinned to the caller's own; 501 when no audit store is configured.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Result keeps only rows with that outcome (success, denied, ...).

get.summary:
health reports that the compliance surface is serving and which identity
provider is wired.
get.description:
health reports that the compliance surface is serving and which identity
provider is wired. It does NOT probe that provider — a provider outage must not
fail liveness.

get.summary:
listRecords returns the caller org's verifications and accreditation records
together.
get.description:
listRecords returns the caller org's verifications and accreditation records
together. Every row carries opaque ids and statuses only — subject PII stays in
the subject store.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

get.summary:
status returns the org's compliance posture: the wired provider and the count of
its verifications per provider-reported status.
get.description:
status returns the org's compliance posture: the wired provider and the count of
its verifications per provider-reported status. It is deliberately NOT a boolean
"compliant" — the platform reports what providers said, nothing more.

get.summary: listSubjects returns the caller org's subjects without their contact PII: a row
get.description:
listSubjects returns the caller org's subjects without their contact PII: a row
says whether an email is on file, never what it is.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

post.summary: createSubject records a person or business to verify.
post.description:
createSubject records a person or business to verify. It needs an email or the
org's own ref. Contact PII is sealed at rest and never returned by a list read.

get.summary: getSubject returns one of the caller org's subjects INCLUDING its contact PII.
get.description:
getSubject returns one of the caller org's subjects INCLUDING its contact PII.
This is the only surface that discloses it, and only to the owning org.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the subject id from the path, as returned by create.

get.summary: listVerifications returns the caller org's verifications, each with its
get.description:
listVerifications returns the caller org's verifications, each with its
provider-reported status and no subject PII.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

post.summary:
startVerification opens a KYC/KYB verification for a subject through the wired
provider, creating the subject inline when no subjectId is given.
post.description:
startVerification opens a KYC/KYB verification for a subject through the wired
provider, creating the subject inline when no subjectId is given. A start is
never a decision: the record comes back pending even if the provider reports
otherwise, so no path here yields a verified check.

get.summary: getVerification returns one of the caller org's verifications with its current
get.description:
getVerification returns one of the caller org's verifications with its current
recorded status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the verification id from the path, as returned by start.

post.summary:
decideVerification records a reviewer's manual decision on a verification — the
human-in-the-loop path, and the only route to a passing status when no real
provider is wired.
post.description:
decideVerification records a reviewer's manual decision on a verification — the
human-in-the-loop path, and the only route to a passing status when no real
provider is wired. It requires an org admin or platform reviewer and is
attributed to them, and it can only record reviewer_confirmed or manual_review.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the verification id from the path; a body value is ignored.

post.summary:
refreshVerification is the internal PULL reconcile: an org member triggers a poll of
the wired provider for the current decision.
post.description:
refreshVerification is the internal PULL reconcile: an org member triggers a poll of
the wired provider for the current decision. For the Manual provider this stays
pending; for a hosted provider it reflects the provider's settled status,
provider-attributed. A poll error is a 502, never a verification.
refreshVerification polls the wired provider for a verification's current
decision and records it, attributed to the provider. With the manual provider it
stays pending; a poll error is a 502 and never a verification.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the verification id from the path, as returned by start.

id.description: ID is the accreditation id from the path; a body value is ignored.

status.description: Status must be reviewer_confirmed, provider_verified, rejected or expired.

data.description: Data is one row per accreditation record.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer is the boundary made visible on the wire.

basis.description:
Basis is what qualifies the subject: income, net_worth,
professional_license or entity.

evidenceDocId.description: EvidenceDocID references the supporting document, if any.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is the unix second the assertion lapses, 0 for none.

method.description:
Method is how the state was established: self_attested, third_party_letter
or provider_verified.

note.description: Note is a non-PII operator note.

status.description:
Status may only be asserted (or empty, which means asserted). Every
confirmed, rejected or expired state is set through the decision endpoint,
so it always carries the reviewer who recorded it.

subjectId.description: SubjectID is the subject the assertion is about; it must exist in the org.

basis.description: Basis is what qualifies the subject.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the unix second the record was created.

evidenceDocId.description: EvidenceDocID references the supporting document, when one is named.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is the unix second the record lapses, when one is set.

method.description: Method is how the state was established.

note.description: Note is a non-PII operator note, when one is set.

reviewerSub.description: ReviewerSub is the org user who recorded the decision, once decided.

status.description: Status is the tracked state: asserted until a reviewer decides.

subjectId.description: SubjectID is the opaque subject the record is about.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the unix second of the last recorded change.

data.description:
Data is one row per privileged compliance action: who started or decided
what, and when. It is pinned to the caller's own org.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer is the boundary made visible on the wire.

id.description: ID is the verification id from the path; a body value is ignored.

status.description:
Status must be reviewer_confirmed (a pass) or manual_review (withhold). A
provider_verified or provider_rejected status is the provider's to report and
is refused here.

id.description: ID is the verification id from the path, as returned by start.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the unix second the verification was started.

decidedAt.description: DecidedAt is the unix second it reached a terminal status.

decidedBy.description: DecidedBy names who settled it: the provider, or the reviewer's user id.

provider.description: Provider is the identity provider that holds the verification.

status.description: Status is provider-reported or pending — never platform-asserted.

subjectId.description: SubjectID is the opaque subject this verifies.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the unix second of the last recorded change.

verifyUrl.description: VerifyURL is where the subject completes verification, while one is open.

disclaimer.description:
Disclaimer is the boundary made visible on the wire: Hanzo records what
licensed providers report; it does not itself determine compliance.

provider.description: Provider is the wired identity-verification provider.

verifications.description: Verifications is the per-status tally of the org's verifications.

provider.description: Provider is the wired identity-verification provider.

status.description: Status is "ok" while the surface is serving.

accreditation.description: Accreditation is the org's accreditation records, tracked.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer is the boundary made visible on the wire.

verifications.description: Verifications are the org's KYC/KYB checks, provider-reported.

email.description: Email is contact PII, for an inline subject; sealed at rest.

kind.description: Kind is individual or business, for an inline subject.

name.description: Name is contact PII, for an inline subject; sealed at rest.

ref.description: Ref is the org's own opaque external id, for an inline subject.

subjectId.description:
SubjectID verifies an existing subject. When empty, one is created inline
from kind/ref/email/name.

ref.description: the org's own opaque external id for this subject

data.description:
Data is one row per subject. It carries no name or email — only whether an
email is on file — so a list read never sprays PII.

email.description:
Email is contact PII, sealed at rest and returned only on a single-subject
read to the owning org. Required when no ref is given.

kind.description: Kind is individual or business, required.

name.description: Name is contact PII, sealed at rest.

ref.description: Ref is the org's own opaque external id; required when no email is given.

data.description:
Data is one row per verification, each carrying only opaque ids and the
provider-reported status — never subject PII.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer is the boundary made visible on the wire.

byStatus.description: ByStatus is the count per status, one key per status seen.

total.description: Total is the sum across statuses.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the unix second the subject was recorded.

hasEmail.description: HasEmail reports whether contact email is on file, without disclosing it.

id.description: ID is the subject id, the value every verification and accreditation names.

ref.description: Ref is the org's own opaque external id for this subject.
